322c9d922994.headline: AAA on FOX Results: La Catalina Appears, Wagner Brothers Defend Tag Titles
322c9d922994.summary: Lucha Libre AAA aired its latest AAA on FOX episode on October 17 on Fox Latin America and YouTube. Reigning AAA Reina de Reinas Champion La Catalina appeared on the show, and the Wagner Brothers defended the AAA World Tag Team Championship. Full results are in Fightful's results section.
